decisions.reason: As a sheet preparation module that extends the firm's existing finishing workflow know-how, it fits high absorptive capacity and is likely to be retained unless portfolio simplification frees resources for stronger priorities.
The B2-format multifinisher remains close to the firm's core competencies and strategic direction, so management would usually continue backing it in a growing market rather than withdraw it quickly.
The folding add-on unit builds directly on the installed base and already has a documented customer application, which reduces uncertainty and supports keeping it on the market.
